paper_title: VisuoThink Empowering LVLM Reasoning with Multimodal Tree Search
caption: The performance gain (+%) on tasks through predictive rollout search. The performance gain is calculated via the performance gap between VisuoThink (w/o rollout search) and VisuoThink.
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the performance gain percentage for three models, GPT-4o, Claude-3.5-Sonnet, and Qwen2-72B-VL, under two supervision conditions: strong supervision and weak supervision. The horizontal axis lists the model names, while the vertical axis represents the performance gain percentage, ranging from 0 to 30 in increments of 5. Each model is represented by a pair of bars, with striped blue bars indicating strong supervision and solid blue bars representing weak supervision. The performance gain for strong supervision is approximately 24% for GPT-4o, 9% for Claude-3.5-Sonnet, and 15% for Qwen2-72B-VL, while for weak supervision, it is around 5% for GPT-4o, 3% for Claude-3.5-Sonnet, and 5% for Qwen2-72B-VL. The chart does not display any specific sorting order for the bars, and no bars are visually emphasized.
